notes.title: New Beta Playtest now available!
notes.content:
Dear Explorers and Urbex fans!

New beta version is now available for everyone to try via Steam Playtest! 🔥

We are super grateful to those who gave us feedback to the previous demo version and we know you've been patiently waiting for this update. We are excited to know if you like the changes and we look forward to further feedback from you. 👍

To play the new version ➡️ just click the green "Request Access" button on our Steam page ➡️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/88fdbe6f0c86b37cb92ab66dc3c201f2a0c39606.png

While we're working hard on full version of the game, we found some time to also prepare a new Teaser Trailer 🎬 to show a little bit more of the climate and setting we want to achieve in the game. We hope you like it!

[previewyoutube=m-wS0vNQ6OY;full][/previewyoutube]

Please find the list of added features and bug fixes below:

What features were added:

 Added player’s quarters 
 Added tutorial minigame accessible from PC in Player's room 
 Added head bobbing and possibility to disable it in settings
 Added ability to jump off the wall in the desired direction
 Added ability to control character while jumping
 Added ability to change height of the camera while player moves
 Added collectibles with item browser
 Added the ability to climb small obstacles without a need of jumping over them
 Added the ability to remove fuses
 Added a gas mask
 Added ability to jump on dumpsters without a run-up
 Added pendrive mechanics
 Added chess puzzle
 Added map to quarters
 Added info about leaving particular location
 Added motion sensor
 Added task list to the quarters
 Added some places to hide from guards
 Added possibility to run and jump while holding an object
 Added inbox and mails arriving at the start of the game

Improvements:

 Various fixes on prison level design
 Improved UI -  added inventory and detection icons
 Improved climbing and moving around the edge
 Improved camera hang when jumping while running on a wall
 Improved edge detection
 Improved navigation of guards in prison
 Improved crawling animation
 Various UI fixes  

and much more!

Join Urban Explorer Community!
Join our Discord and let’s talk more about Urban Explorer and urbex in general!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/8acf392d1399a2fca9cf4c25ec96c0d17eebf672.png

Take care, 
Urban Explorer Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111840/Urban_Explorer/

https://i.imgur.com/qwnfS1y.gif

notes.title: Devlog #5: New features and bugfixes
notes.content:
Dear Urbex Fans!

Welcome to another development update! 

We are super grateful to those who patiently waited and cheered for us on our social media. We look forward to every feedback from you and do our best to live up to your expectations. 👊

While we're woking hard on full version of the game, we found some time to refine the demo version as well. For those who haven't seen our demo version yet - we hope that you will welcome it warmly! 

Please find the list of added features and bug fixes below:

What features were added:

 Added mouse invert Y and X axis option
 The ability to jump out of a window and jump onto smaller objects has been improved
 Player slide duration extended
 Added motion blur option

Bugfixes:

 Player no longer clipping through lockpick camera
 Fixed loading screen - (loading screen won't fade until game is loaded so the popup about loading level shouldn't be visible anymore)
 Fixed a bug that caused the alarm sound to not always play
 Fixed a bug that caused the player to fall after each jump
 Fixed a bug that made the guards' footsteps inaudible to the player
 Fixed many places where the player could get stuck
 Adjusted the default volume of in-game sounds

We look forward to you trying it out and sharing your opinion! You create this game with us!

Join Urban Explorer Community!
Join our Discord and let’s talk more about Urban Explorer and urbex in general!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/8acf392d1399a2fca9cf4c25ec96c0d17eebf672.png

Take care, 
Urban Explorer Team

notes.title: Urban Explorer demo is now available!
notes.content:
Be prepared, Explorers!

We hope you are as excited as we are about our participation in Steam Next Fest, because on this occasion we can proudly announce that the demo version of Urban Explorer is now available!

Let your curiosity take over and discover a mysterious, abandoned prison, but keep caution and common sense in mind! You will need it, trust us.  

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35401883/512705cf3706926168f3253dd6ec0266c51c1ccd.png

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35401883/c4cef97f5ada49026e978b9aece0bead306f172d.png

And if you’d like to meet our developers and learn more about the game and future ideas for the development, we truly encourage you to join our livestream which will take place October 10, 5pm UTC+01:00 on Twitch and Steam!

See you soon!

notes.title: Big Reveal!
notes.content:
Greetings, Urbex community!

After a bit of a break, we're thrilled to announce that we've restarted development on Urban Explorer, and we're preparing to release a demo version during Steam Next Fest this October!

🎮 Today, we're launching our demo playtest registration, offering you the chance to experience the game before the demo goes live. Your feedback holds immense value to us, and once you've had a go at it, we'd be honored if you could take a moment to share your thoughts and suggestions via our feedback form. We aim to address your suggestions as fast as possible.

👷‍♂️ We worked hard over the past few months to bring this demo to life. While not every mechanic is ready, we want to show you the main features of the game and hear your opinions about it.

🛠️ In our next post, we'll unveil some of the mechanics we have in mind for the full version of the game. We're genuinely open to your ideas, and who knows, some of them might find their way into the game!

🌾 Some of you might remember the Abandoned Silo location from our old devlogs. Well, we've decided to explore a different path. Here's a sneak peek for you:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/e240c79ee61ab205ebb988dc09e48128a2c27baa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/f210bfe9f4ba855b85135e6efeff9408114c5e0c.jpg

🔄 Please bear in mind that this is an extremely early version of the game, and everything is subject to change as we work towards creating the best possible experience for all Urbex enthusiasts.

Happy Playtesting!

notes.title: Devlog #4: Storage full of secrets
notes.content:
Dear Urban Explorers!

Today we’d like to give you a little update about our development progress.

As you may already know from our previous DevLog #3, in the last few months we were focused on creating a new location and polishing parkour mechanics of our game. If you’re not familiar with the details, make sure to read the previous DevLog. You can see some screenshots of the new location there!

We have recently shifted our focus to buildings available in the new Abandoned Silo location. To be more precise, we’re now working on interiors you’ll be able to explore. You’ll need to rely on your parkour skills to get to them, as in some cases it’s going to be a great challenge! 

What kind of areas can you expect to see? 
> Building complex of Abandoned Silo
> Workshop
> Storehouse
> Office building
> Tower
> Security building
> Open area littered with containers

You can see some of these areas below, namely, the area with containers, workshop, storehouse and toilet room. How do you like the atmosphere so far? :)

notes.title: Devlog #3: Urbex Location #1
notes.content:
Dear Urbex Fans! 

As promised, we have a sneak peek of one of the locations that will be available in Urban Explorer! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/ed88779a1bc30e7a0c5f81bc00c29c5420e28097.png

Our team is working hard on the Abandoned Silo location. We’ve collected lots of reference photos and videos and based on them, we’re designing the level and doing our best to make it as exciting and challenging as possible! 

Keep in mind that this is not the final name of this location, and new development screenshots don’t represent the final look of the location and the game. We’re still working on post-processing, buildings and other improvements. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/c3052404a6d6e2ce44a5b7bd15c88b47de2899fa.png

As the name of the location suggests, there you will be able to explore the abandoned silo with many secret rooms to discover. Getting there might be a little challenging, you will have to use your parkour skills... but watch out! You may bump into someone, who won’t be happy about your visit there… 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/e32cdf15548aad03d20c1035589ff43df8daeed5.png

We will soon test the parkour mechanics in this level and make nice gifs for you! 
Would you like to visit this location? ːsteamhappyː

Join Urban Explorer Community! 
Join our Discord and let’s talk more about Urban Explorer and urbex in general!

notes.title: Devlog #2: Parkour Mechanics #2
notes.content:
Dear Urbex Fans!

Welcome to the next development update!  This month we are busy working on locations that you will visit in Urban Explorer. We also continue working on parkour mechanics and testing them in the pre-alpha build. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/5b6d3a0f6b22035b312b32e8c7c60a450f83470f.png

We're doing our best to make our parkour mechanics as good as possible. Currently, we're mainly testing and improving jumping, climbing, wall-running, etc. 

https://i.imgur.com/4f8qrvN.gif

Perfecting parkour mechanics is crucial because you'll often have to use your parkour abilities to avoid security or areas that, at first glance, seem inaccessible. 

https://i.imgur.com/BnzWimz.gif

Additionally, we're doing research and collecting reference photos and videos of various impressive abandoned buildings, secret facilities, catacombs, etc. As we mentioned on our Social Media channels while working on new locations, we're looking for some inspiration!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/394a6c9a1277154b3aa0ad8d3b018d59ab8b6f76.png

Don't hesitate to share with us your favorite urbex locations that you would like to explore in our game. Cooperation with the community is essential! Join our dedicated Discord Server and post your suggestions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/8acf392d1399a2fca9cf4c25ec96c0d17eebf672.png

Stay safe! 
Urbex Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111840/Urban_Explorer/

notes.title: Devlog #1: Parkour Mechanics #1
notes.content:
Dear Urbex Fans!

Welcome to our first Urban Explorer devlog! We are happy to inform you that we’ll be posting development updates every month to share with you information about the current progress and some sneak peeks of new locations and gameplay mechanics! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/b16e66bcac39d6e5d437649161b2fb6abbf71bcd.png

Recently, we’ve been working on parkour mechanics, such as running, jumping, sliding and wall-running. We’ve prepared a pre-alpha build to test these mechanics and player movement. Below you can take a look at gifs showing jumping and sliding.

https://i.imgur.com/wof11tt.gif

https://i.imgur.com/tN3sozp.gif

Keep in mind that the game is still in development, and gifs shown above were recorded in pre-alpha build, and they don’t reflect the final version of the game. We’re also working on several locations separately. Once we’re satisfied with the mechanics and the player movement, we will prepare another build with the testing location. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35401883/da842dae47dab37bd41fe74043f79fd9ba3906e0.png

Feel free to join our dedicated Discord Server, where you can talk about Urban Explorer, ask any questions and share your suggestions! Let us know what locations you want to explore in our game! 

Stay safe! 
Urbex Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111840/Urban_Explorer/
